title: Care, Storage, Operation, Handling and Shipping of Magnetic Recording Tape for Television
scope: This document provides guidance to technical managers, archivists, and technicians for the care, storage, operation, handling, and shipping conditions that help maximize the life expectancy of television (video) magnetic recording tape.
